### 💡 Intuition & Approach

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def triton_mean_variance(x: list) -> dict:
    arr = np.array(x, dtype=float)
    return {'mean': round(float(np.mean(arr)), 6), 'variance': round(float(np.var(arr)), 6)}
```
